answers.text:
# Winter Makers' Fair 2026

Saturday 12 December 2026, 10:00 to 16:00

Old Tram Depot, 4 Quay Street, Riverside

More than 60 stalls of ceramics, prints, woodwork and food from local makers. Live music from noon.

## Tickets

Ticket details soon. Sign up to our newsletter to hear first.

## Get in touch

Use the contact form on our About page. Stallholder applications are closed for this year.

Posted 2026-10-02.
